facts.text: On 2023-01-23 (step 1) the sea surface temperature around Mauritius was 27.12 °C.
On 2023-08-01 (step 20) the sea surface temperature was 24.77 °C.
From 2023-01-23 to 2023-08-01 the reading changed by -2.35 °C.
The largest fall between two readings was 0.73 °C, from step 14 to step 15.
There is no data for 2023-02-02: NASA published no map for that date. This is a gap, not a zero.
Each reading is the average of the sea points in a box around Mauritius, from west 56.8 to east 58.4 degrees, and south -21 to north -19.4 degrees. The box is 160 by 160 map points.
Each map point is only known to within a colour range of 0.15 °C. The average is not exact.
Land has no sea temperature. The sea covers 93.75% of the box.
There is one reading every 10 days.
The temperatures come from the MUR sea surface temperature analysis by NASA JPL, shown through NASA GIBS.
This record shows what the maps say. It does not say why the temperature changed.
